# Fio - Subscription Billing API for PIX

> Fio is a developer-first subscription billing engine for PIX payments in Brazil.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://docs.fio.com.br/quickstart) - Create your first PIX charge in 5 minutes
- [Subscription Guide](https://docs.fio.com.br/guides/subscription-billing) - Full subscription lifecycle
- [API Reference](https://docs.fio.com.br/api) - Complete API documentation
- [Webhooks](https://docs.fio.com.br/webhooks) - Event types and webhook setup

## SDK

```bash
npm install @fio-pay/sdk
```

```typescript
import { Fio } from '@fio-pay/sdk'

const fio = new Fio({ apiKey: 'fio_test_your_key_here' })

// Create a customer
const customer = await fio.customers.create({
  name: 'Customer Name',
  email: 'customer@example.com',
  tax_id: '12345678909',
  tax_id_type: 'cpf',
})

// Create a PIX charge
const charge = await fio.charges.create({
  customer_id: customer.id,
  amount: 4990, // R$ 49.90 in centavos
  expires_in: 3600,
})

// Create a subscription
const plan = await fio.plans.create({
  name: 'Pro Monthly',
  amount: 4990,
  interval: 'month',
})

const subscription = await fio.subscriptions.create({
  customer_id: customer.id,
  plan_id: plan.id,
})
```

## API Base URL

Production: https://api.fio.com.br/v1
Sandbox: Same URL, use `fio_test_` API keys

## Key Concepts

- All amounts in BRL centavos (integer)
- All timestamps in ISO 8601 UTC
- Authentication via Bearer token (API key)
- Cursor-based pagination
- Idempotency-Key header on POST/PUT
